SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.resource_id AS source_id, 'resource' AS source_type, r.title AS source_title, c.content, c.parent_id, c.deleted, c.create_time, c.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE parent_id = c.id AND deleted = 0) AS reply_count FROM comment c LEFT JOIN resource r ON c.resource_id = r.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT pc.id, pc.post_id AS source_id, 'post' AS source_type, p.title AS source_title, pc.content, pc.parent_id, pc.deleted, pc.create_time, pc.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE parent_id = pc.id AND deleted = 0) AS reply_count FROM post_comment pc LEFT JOIN post p ON pc.post_id = p.id WHERE pc.user_id = #{userId} AND pc.deleted = 0 ) merged ORDER BY create_time DESC
